def factor_range_vol_of_vol_signed_power(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    mean_range = range_.rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    std_range = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
    cv = std_range / mean_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    signed_power_cv = np.sign(cv) * np.abs(cv) ** (1.0 / 3.0)
    factor = -signed_power_cv
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_signed_power"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_signed_power"]
description: Preserves the primary range vol-of-vol mean-reversion mechanism from range_vol_vol_of_vol_mean_reversion: high volatility of daily range relative to its trailing mean indicates unstable price formation and predicts lower forward returns. Borrows the signed cube-root normalization from volume_price_elasticity to compress extreme vol-of-vol ratios, reducing outlier influence and potentially improving top-quantile payoff thickness while retaining the monotonic ranking of the raw signal. The lightweight modifier is a nonlinear compression, not a second feature.
